title: How to Short Bitcoin Using Options | Interview with Krown's Crypto Cave
description:
Prominent YouTuber and trader Eric Crown explains how he uses options to short Bitcoin during an upward trend. He also gives an overview of the current movements in the market, explaining why the recent drop in prices is actually a “bear trap.”
